rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Bella di Todi ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Anna Medici Barni (Italy, before 1999).
Introduced in Italy by Rose Barni in 1999 as 'Bella di Todi'.
Introduced in United States by Roses Unlimited in 2005 as 'Bella di Todi'.
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow, apricot shading, lighter outer petals. Strong fragrance. 60 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, full (26-40 petals), cupped, quartered, rosette bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Short, upright. Medium, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Vigorous.
